headline: Approved $8,509,830 wastewater loan, Tier 1A housing resolution (amended 9-3), Boardroom entertainment permit, and other consent items.
summary: The council adopted a Tier 1A status resolution after amending it 9-3, then passed it unanimously as amended. It also approved several consent agenda items, including a $8,509,830 wastewater plant loan, a $108,000 ecosystem services study, bond resolutions, and licenses for The Boardroom and What Ales You.
decisions: Approved a 3-year extension (with a 4th-year option) of the Burlington Electric Department's agreement with Shelburne Limestone Corporation.
Approved use of $108,000 from the Conservation Legacy Fund for an ecosystem services analysis.
Approved the Resolution authorizing Parking Revenue Financing for the Department of Public Works.
Approved the Resolution authorizing Capital Improvement Bonds for Fiscal Year 2027 and Public Improvement Infrastructure Bonds under the March 4, 2025 voter authorization.

Adopted a resolution authorizing an $8,509,830 Step II loan from the Vermont Clean Water State Revolving Fund and related contracts with Wright-Pierce ($6,343,550), PC Construction ($1,126,480), and Stantec ($396,000) for Main Wastewater Plant Improvements (Stage 1).
Adopted a resolution authorizing the Director of Public Works to execute grant agreements with the Northern Border Regional Commission.
Approved the 2026-2027 Indoor Entertainment Permit Application for The Boardroom, 3 Mill Street, with all standard conditions.
Approved the 2026-2027 Tobacco License Application for What Ales You, 167 Main Street.
Amended the Tier 1A Status resolution 9-3 by roll call, then adopted the amended resolution unanimously by voice vote.
